description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaluarachchiyagama, Nachchaduwa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110627 (23/1109)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to numerous parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, ownership details, and encumbrances, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
